latestVersion.changelog:
video-editor-with-ai-image 1.0.0

- Initial release: AI-powered video editor that transforms images and clips into videos with transitions and background music.
- Supports uploads of JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV files up to 200MB.
- Cloud-based rendering with automatic setup—no editing software needed.
- Simple user prompts trigger editing, exporting, credit check, and more.
- Session-based workflow with automatic token handling and helpful status/error messages.
